decision.explanation: The question asks for the release date of the album titled 'Killswitch Engage'. The source documents identify two distinct albums with this exact title: the debut album (2000) and the fifth studio album (2009). D1S1 explicitly states the 2000 album was released on 'July 4, 2000', and D2S2 explicitly states the 2009 album was released on 'June 30, 2009'. Both are valid answers corresponding to distinct referents (different albums by the same band), so both dates are retained.
